promise_rule: ADR-0156: numbered Success Metrics and API Contracts or explicit reasoned None, with named Task consumption
core_features: Features 1-5 map by name into TechSpec Coverage Map and Task References
api_contracts: explicit None with no product command change
vocabulary_skip_resolution: No product vocabulary emitted or changed; script fixture and residual inventory name test-suite implementation terms. CONTEXT.md remains unchanged and needs neither term. Run Budget, Owner PID and Run retain their existing meanings.
result_evidence: Each non-QA Task Result names focused commands and outcomes. Prior Task Result failures are explicitly historical, not presented as current verification passes.
